question: For three short source-bound opening scenes, record what fixed local policies propose from FEN alone, including raw parse/legality failures and differences from the next displayed source move. This is an illustration, not an accepted benchmark.

source_binding.human_mainline_validation: Pending; source3 contains nearby hypothetical branches/rewinds
source_binding.original_game_identity: Unknown for all three; entire-game exclusion cannot be certified
source_binding.media_rights: Private authorized viewing only; no creator-media training or redistribution

base_classifier_9m.condition: Frozen existing weights; no scene tuning, training or selection
base_classifier_9m.loader: Stock transformers LlamaForSequenceClassification; reviewed native adapter; no HF remote code execution

selected_classifier_9m_step512.condition: Frozen existing weights; no scene tuning, training or selection
selected_classifier_9m_step512.loader: Stock transformers LlamaForSequenceClassification; reviewed native adapter; no HF remote code execution

base_language_policy_124m.condition: Frozen existing weights; no scene tuning, training or selection
base_language_policy_124m.loader: Stock transformers AutoModelForCausalLM and local pinned tokenizer; no remote code

planned_denominators.failure_retention: Every planned ID remains, including load/encode/model/parse/illegal failures and not_run outcomes

generation_inputs.position_id: Bookkeeping only; never inserted into model prompt or tokens
generation_inputs.isolation: Each FEN is an independent stateless request; reset any model conversation/history between cases

classifier_policy.representation: Reviewed native77-character FEN plus CLS,78 tokens, exact metadata/action-space validation; reject unsupported inputs without truncation
classifier_policy.prediction: One forward pass per position; full1968logits saved with ID/FEN/model binding
classifier_policy.raw: Stable descending logits then lower class ID; report raw top1 and top5, UCI legality
classifier_policy.legal_mask_diagnostic: Report separately top5 legal classes from the same logits and intervention flag; never replace or hide raw output in common metrics

language_policy.representation: Literal P: plus currentFEN padded to90 characters then M:, no teacher or video labels
language_policy.parser: Strip whitespace; remove one optional initial M: marker; take only first whitespace token; require full orthodox UCI syntax; never recover later text or B: output
retention: Exact input token IDs and attention mask
Complete generated token IDs and raw completion including trailing text
First-token parsed action, parse validity and raw legality
Explicit per-case failures and not_run outcomes

evaluator_separation.phase1: Load only frozen FEN input file and model metadata, generate and save all raw outputs or explicit failures. Do not read candidate ledger contents. The prebound ledger SHA is a provenance constant only.
evaluator_separation.phase2: Close inference, save immutable raw-result hashes and exact executed-source/model/runtime bindings.
evaluator_separation.phase3: Separate evaluator loads hash-verified ledger and joins next_displayed_move_evaluator_only by position ID. Compute per-case match-to-displayed-move only after raw outputs are frozen.
evaluator_separation.not_an_answer_key: Displayed source moves are not verified best moves or authenticated frontier-model decisions; source3 variation status is explicit.
evaluator_separation.diagnostics: No Stockfish calls in this plan; legality from orthodox chess rules is evaluator-only except separately marked classifier mask diagnostics

accounting.primary_common: For each model show planned3, completed, parsed/raw action, raw-legal count, failure counts and all3 rows. No pooled ranking.
accounting.source_move_agreement: Descriptive integer count out of all3 only; parse/error/illegal remains in denominator. Do not call this accuracy, improvement or strength.
accounting.latency: Per-case warm/cold status and measured latency, model/runtime/device and exception types; no performance speed claim from n=3
accounting.no_selection: No policy/checkpoint/hyperparameter/prompt changes based on these outputs; do not promote a preferred model from three scenes

retention.overwrite_policy: Refuse an existing run directory; preserve partial failures
before_calls: Model weights and config/tokenizer/class mapping hashes
after_calls: All retained raw logits or generated strings/tokens
Source-ledger evaluator join and complete denominator summary

execution_precondition: Parent confirms v4GPU run is complete and GPU is available; no model/LLM/engine call authorized by writing this plan alone. Parent owns subsequent execution.
limitations: Three short standard opening scenes are intentionally illustrative and too small/easy for generalization
Zero accepted holdouts; no human original-game/mainline certification
Classifiers provide move classes, not ideas or grounded commentary
First-M language-policy task differs from original full-native B:first policy; no cross-protocol strength comparison
No authenticated frontier model identity/prompt/compute baseline from edited creator videos
Legality masking is explicit external rule assistance
No Elo, language understanding, commentary quality, teaching or sports-transfer conclusion
Codex-assisted work; this plan does not impersonate human research or satisfy formal project promotion gates
